dimensions.note: The monograph's central account is that her development widens the reasons for which she may strive, belong, receive care and stop, without victory or indispensable usefulness as the price of remaining herself (section 2). It separates four effort regimes with characteristic dangers and counterpressures (section 6.1), tests the account against thirteen rival readings with dispositions (section 12) and states what would weaken it. The ledger tracks the V02 regime by goal, comparison reference, stopping condition and self-worth coupling (sections 6-7) and the V06.5 running regime in the same fields (section 31.2). The model turns this into eight conditional mechanisms MM1-MM8, each with alternative modes and a stated evidence strength. A is not supported because the monograph calls the thesis a contestable synthesis, the model declines any invariant motive ranking, and it abstains on outcomes under new severe comparison. Conditional mechanisms with rejected rivals exceed a descriptive profile, so C would understate them.

The monograph gives a band table from the recalled middle-school history through V12, each with what changes and what does not follow (section 3), preserves the V11 state vector (section 4) and adds a V12 revision matrix (section 17.7). The model binds behavior to thirteen state selectors NM-S1 to NM-S13, each listing what is available and what stays unavailable, and warns against advancing every dimension when one changes. The ledger records her regime per volume (sections 6, 12.1, 17.2, 25.3, 31.2, 38, 54.2, 82). A is not supported because the fresh primary returns are selective windows, V04 was not reverified or reread, V01, V03 and V10 had integrity checks only, and nothing after V12 is established; per-state ceilings exceed a period profile, so C would understate them.

The discovery row claims speech. Section 10.1 gives an attested-mode table with Japanese wording (the mock-formal ワタクシ, ブレーン for the campaign partnership, そーいう意味の好き, 今日とかも…よさそー, スペック against 『私』そのもの) and separates forms of address for Fumiya, Tama, Hinami and Kikuchi; section 17.7 adds V12 small-voiced fear, direct self-account and a jargon joke. The model records a bounded local written-register review and section 3 selects register by recipient and clock. B is not supported because the monograph calls these samples a differentiated voice, not a statistical idiolect, and the model gives neither frequencies, pitch, a full idiolect nor permission for freeform Japanese. Quoted samples with recipient-specific address forms exceed a prose description, so D is not supported.

Section 9.1 is a preference register that classifies each observation by strength of evidence and states what it does and does not support: lively group fun and karaoke, a shrimp dislike that is not a seafood aversion, crab-cream pasta, a stated weakness with spicy food, substantial meal orders, milky sweet tea varied in the cafe, running-shoe fit, changed grooming after retirement, getting lost and asking a clerk, a dog image sent to Tama, and the shared strap. Sections 9.2-9.7 and the model's MM1 use these. B is not supported because most rows rest on one scene, the model rates low-stakes modeling only as moderate, and the monograph lists music, colors, reading, sleep, occupation and household routine as unknown. A classified register across V05-V09 exceeds a list of habits, so D is not supported.

Section 8 differentiates Tama (return-seeking play, reciprocal concealed care, the V12 separation fear), Hinami (validating rival, limited analogy, Hinami's private inferior-copy portrait kept as her model), Fumiya (campaign partner, comic partner, romantic subject, corrected friend), Kikuchi (comparison, unfair testing corrected into disclosure, V12 severe inquiry), the mother, peers and council juniors, and Yamashita and Ashigaru as observers. The model's section 3 selects register and act by recipient and standing, and the ledger records Tama as a separate evaluative system (section 7). A is not supported because Tama gives no new answer in V12, unfamiliar recipients are unattested, and the dyad and ensemble specialists that own both directions are not curated on this subject; differentiated, standing-bounded responses across many attested recipients exceed a relational sketch, so C would understate them.

Unlike most principals she has private focalization: the V05 two-viewpoint bonus, the V06.5 running, camp, gyoza and post-declaration chapters, and the V08.5 cafe story (NM-P06-P14, P20-P21), together with V11 and V12 addressed self-accounts. Section 10.4 treats her account as privileged access rather than a final verdict: the decorated-frame metaphor coexists in the same chapter with desires, decisions and attachments. A is not supported because private access is concentrated in supplements, the main volumes are mostly Fumiya's narration, and the monograph keeps open whether her V11 account is acceptance or resignation; direct private narration with explicit epistemic limits exceeds inference from behavior, so C would understate it.

Located conflict and pressure: the V02 continue-or-stop statement, resignation from track and defended walk (NM-P03-P04; ledger sections 6.3-6.4), the V07 redirection of Fumiya to Kikuchi at cost to herself, the V08.5 indirect testing she recognizes as unfair and replaces with disclosure, the V09 walk begun over his protest, and the V12 challenge to the event fallback plan. The model gives MM2 and MM5 with alternative modes. B is not supported because the model rates new refusal and contact outcomes as low, states the exact choice remains restricted and abstains on outcomes under new severe comparison; mechanism-level treatment of several located conflicts exceeds incidents alone, so D is not supported.

Her own moral reasoning is rendered: V02 shame that she even feels envy toward a harder-working friend (section 3.5), the V08.5 statement that she will not do wrong while staying honest about feeling, the hedged V09 restraint, and the V12 two reasons for not pressing a weakened Fumiya to choose her, his good and her own self-liking (section 17.4). B is not supported because the model states a hypothetical new ethical choice still requires facts about the act and the people affected, probes 15.8 and 15.9 give low confidence on what she would do with unauthorized information or a direct refusal, and the monograph separates its own normative assessment of her methods from her deliberation; self-stated reasons in several episodes exceed recorded positions, so D is not supported.

Section 5.1 distinguishes exaggerated self-introduction, mock interviews, playful status claims, deliberate nonsense, fast retort, staged overconfidence and teasing familiarity, and section 5.2 separates their affiliative and defensive functions, including the V02 walk where topic-making keeps a question out. Failures are recorded: the V07 stage joke gets no laugh yet helps Fumiya recover, a theatrical entrance confuses a junior, and Kikuchi rejects the war metaphor. The model's MM1 and MM6 condition play on recipient and field. A is not supported because the model rates support as weak for an exact joke or an unsampled recipient and humor is described more than quoted; a function-differentiated account with located failures exceeds scattered mentions, so C would understate it.

Three reviewed items: a mature monograph with independent review through V12, a root-accepted derived-use model, and the effort ledger, whose curated coverage on the discovery row is V01-V02 specialist analysis although its text continues through V12. B is not supported because the monograph's primary returns are 31 windows in nine witnesses plus six V12 windows, V04 was not reread, V01, V03 and V10 had integrity checks only, and the character-state, relationship and voice ledgers, readings, integration reviews and dyad specialists it routes to are not curated on this subject. Two dedicated items spanning V01-V12 exceed limited local evidence, so D is not supported.

Affirmative limits and failures are systematic: inattentive listening to Tama, the unfair cafe test, the V09 walk begun over his protest, impulsive touch, and the V12 neglect of event preparation that Ashigaru carries (sections 3.17, 11.1, 17.5); section 11 lists ten tensions with what would overstate their resolution and section 12 rejects thirteen rivals. The ledger records that one race does not cure comparison and that the no-wrongdoing statement is not a stopping rule (sections 31.2, 54.2). The model lists stop-or-branch conditions. A is not supported because these are interpretive dispositions over selective returns, not exhaustive tests; located failures exceed bare gap statements, so C would understate them.

The monograph routes the supplements precisely: the V06.5 girls' conversation to the V03 camp, the running story to after the Tama crisis and before the V06 declaration, the restaurant to a V06 re-presentation, and V08.5 to the V07-V08 interval; it separates the V02 resignation, the V06.5 100-metre farewell race and the V12 200-metre interview race, and the first V09 restraint from the week of separate walks and the resumed walk. The model's selectors keep S9 and S10 apart so later assent cannot authorize the earlier act. A is not supported because returns are selective and V04 and V10 lack fresh reading; paragraph-bounded windows and per-state exclusions exceed a loose period, so C would understate them.

scenario_readiness.note: The model requires era, event domain, recipient, standing, known facts and access routes, present request or refusal, valued activity, commitments and stakes as inputs, gives separately labeled alternatives when they conflict, and defines when to stop or branch; section 15 gives twelve state-conditioned probes with stated confidence and explicit non-predictions. READY is rejected because the probes are not blind, the model abstains on new severe comparison, contact, romance and vocation outcomes, and no accuracy evidence exists; NOT_READY would deny the bounded labeled hypotheticals the model admits.

conditions: Only familiar company and low-stakes outings, meals, running or messaging as near analogs of the located scenes, with the recipient's standing and any stated preference supplied.
Located preferences keep their stated scope (shrimp dislike is not seafood avoidance, a tea variation is not a new habit); no invented music, color, reading, sleep or household routine.

scenario_readiness.note: Sections 9.1-9.7 locate ordinary preferences and company with recipient differences, MM1 models seeking a particular return, and probes 15.2 and 15.11 give state-conditioned ordinary expectations. READY is rejected because the preference register rests mostly on single scenes, the model rates low-stakes modeling as moderate and the monograph lists everyday unknowns; NOT_READY would deny the located, classified ordinary evidence.

Her own reasons are rendered in V02, V08.5, V09 and V12, but the model states that a new ethical choice still requires facts it cannot supply and that her reflective account guarantees neither past nor future methods, and probes 15.8 and 15.9 give low confidence on whether she would receive unauthorized information or stop after a direct refusal. CONDITIONAL would supply weighing the evidence leaves open; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located self-stated reasons.

Romantic material is affirmatively in evidence: no selected interest at the V03 camp, the V06 declaration, the V07 redirection and non-selection, continuing love with a refusal to promise permanence, the V08.5 cafe exchange, the V09 restraint and resumed walk, and the V12 recalled refusal of an opportunistic route. The model states it cannot supply a future romance policy, and probe 15.10 abstains on any new interest, duration of love or contact rule. CONDITIONAL would model a trajectory the evidence leaves open; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located history and the explicit boundary.

conditions: Only school council assistance under permission, novice commentary where a collaborator supplies expertise, and collaborative project work, with initial scope, exposure, assistance and other commitments supplied.
Favorable reception is not a career; the V12 neglected preparation is preserved; no formal office, contract, income or settled vocation is assumed.

scenario_readiness.note: MM6 and MM8 with sections 3.18, 8.5 and 17.5 locate teacher-approved council help, a one-game novice commentary with collaborator expertise that ran longer than agreed, and V12 event preparation she and Fumiya neglected. READY is rejected because the model gives only moderate conditional performance support and no professional trajectory, and the V12 failure is counterevidence to reliable organization; NOT_READY would deny located institutional and public work.

known_limits.statement: Refusing the rematch after the V06.5 100-metre race is a real local stop, not a general stopping rule; no measured time verifies the personal-best aim, and running does not cure comparison in other domains.
Her love continues after non-selection with an explicit refusal to promise permanence; no waiting term, end date, renewed confession or complete contact rule is shown through V12.
In V09 she begins the resumed walk over Fumiya's protest; his later agreement to brief comfort and her V12 ethical self-account do not authorize that initiation retroactively.
Her V08.5 indirect testing of Kikuchi was unfair before she corrected it into direct disclosure; Kikuchi's respect for her feeling does not authorize later acts.

In V12 absorption in the story displaced event preparation she and Fumiya had taken on, and Ashigaru carried the occasion; the useful story does not cancel the neglect, nor does the neglect cancel her earlier initiative.

Her V12 question about a next Tama is a conditional fear about sustaining her own self-liking during possible separation, not an observed or predicted replacement relationship; Tama gives no reply in that exchange.
Hinami's private view of her as a dependent inferior copy is Hinami's model, and Nana's speech is composed fiction; neither is evidence of real Mimimi's state or an additional real conversation.
The V11 novice commentary and council help show capacity, not a chosen career, formal office or gaming expertise.
The monograph's primary returns are selective windows; V04 was not reread and V01, V03 and V10 had integrity checks only, so claims there rest on the preserved readings.

The model's integration review, evidence packet and evaluation records, and the character-state, relationship and voice ledgers, readings and dyad specialists both items route to, are not curated on this subject; no blind accuracy evidence is available here.
No complete idiolect, frequency census, freeform Japanese dialogue or acoustic profile is in evidence.

Music, favorite colors, reading, general sleep habits, occupation, the father's present relationship, household finances and a full family routine are not established; this is a gap, not evidence of incapacity.
Her long-horizon future, the form or end of her love, whether self-regard survives separation from Tama, and any later outcome are not established; nothing after V12 is assessed.
